dataset: Kaggle House Prices and Images - SoCal; 15,474 rows
comparison_method: Same random_state=42 65/15/20 split; separate RandomizedSearchCV runs with 4 candidates and 3 folds; MLPRegressor; original USD metrics; training-split target bounds applied.

image_enhanced_model.features: tabular plus 10 RGB/color statistics and 1,568 HOG descriptors reduced to 24 PCA components

conclusion: The tested handcrafted image-enhanced model performed worse on this held-out split; keep the tabular MLP as the default. This result applies to these handcrafted features and tuning budget, not all possible image models.
